note: Unified task combining the balanced-heterodyne shot-noise characterization (Part A) and the vacuum-vs-weak-coherent-state discrimination (Part B). The two parts share the same apparatus but use different truncations of the same acquisitions, so their frozen inputs live in separate subtrees: /root/input/shot_noise and /root/input/discrimination.

origin.notebook: Data_analysis_1_9_500kHz.ipynb (Part B); shot-noise LO sweep and spectrum records (Part A)
origin.author: Wenjun Ke
origin.description: Part A: vacuum (LO-only) balanced-detector shot-noise measurements over increasing LO power, plus a spectrum-analyzer noise-floor trace and its scope companion. Part B: balanced-heterodyne discrimination of a vacuum state and a very weak coherent state (single vac_2 / sig_2 acquisition pair).

ground_truth_notes.method: Part B beat amplitude taken from the phase-corrected IQ-demodulation displacement (Vpp = 4*|centroid|/T) with the true RF gain 257.988e3 V/W. This is self-consistent: the photon number from power (~11.3) matches the gain-independent photon number from displacement/std (~11.0), the measured/theoretical std ratio is ~1.02, and the measured/theoretical error-rate ratio is ~0.99 (state is ~98% shot-noise-limited).
ground_truth_notes.naive_pitfall: A windowed-FFT beat amplitude loses coherent power to the phase drift over the capture; using it with the true gain underestimates the amplitude, and using it with a compensating smaller gain (215.94e3) over-corrects to ~1.9 pW, which is not shot-noise-consistent. The 2*sqrt(2)*RMS amplitude is inflated by the shot noise itself. The clean displacement-based amplitude avoids both.

shot_noise/heterodyne_data/vac_{1..9}_CH.transform: Kept the header and the first 500000 samples (10 ms at 50 MHz) of each channel; values otherwise unchanged.

shot_noise/spectrum/vac_100uW_CHAN{1,2,3.transform: Kept the header and the first 500000 samples (10 ms at 50 MHz); the oscilloscope companion of the spectrum trace, used to extract LO power.

shot_noise/spectrum/vac_100uW_spectrum.c.transform: Verbatim Anritsu spectrum-analyzer export (dBm, RBW 300 Hz).

discrimination/heterodyne_data/{vac,sig}.transform: Header + first 2400000 samples (48 ms at 50 MHz) of the RF (balanced) output; values otherwise unchanged.
Header + first 100000 samples (exactly 1000 beat periods) of the two LO monitor outputs; only their mean (LO power) is used.
